step1_analysis.circuit_type: Passive Input Test Network (Photodiode Emulator / Matching Network)
step1_analysis.description: A passive network used to emulate a photodiode or interface test equipment to the Transimpedance Amplifier (TIA). It includes AC coupling, series resistance, termination, parasitic capacitance, and bondwire inductance.

paper_reference.title: 1.25-Gb/s Regulated Cascode CMOS Transimpedance Amplifier for Gigabit Ethernet Applications

transimpedance_gain.description: Transimpedance gain of the active TIA (measured here as voltage attenuation of the passive network)

sky130_expected.calculation: For this passive test network, voltage attenuation is 20*log10(Rload / (R1 + R2 + Rload)) = 20*log10(50 / 2050) = -32.25 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated from the resistive divider formed by R1+R2 and the 50-ohm load.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominant pole formed by C2 and parallel resistance Rp = (R1+R2) || Rload = 2000 || 50 = 48.7 ohms. fc = 1 / (2*pi*48.7*1p) = 3.26 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the RC pole of the passive network.

sky130_expected.calculation: Passive network consumes 0 W from VDD.
sky130_expected.reasoning: No active components in the provided netlist.

sky130_expected.calculation: RC delay of the network, approximately 0.69 * Rp * C2 = 0.69 * 48.7 * 1p = 33 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the time constant of the passive components.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure voltage attenuation, 3-dB bandwidth, and propagation delay of the passive input network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Passive Input Network Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* DUT
C1 IN N1 0.1u
R1 N1 N2 1k
R2 N2 N3 1k
R3 IN GND 50
C2 N3 GND 1p
L1 N3 to_chip 1n

* Dummy VDD for power measurement
VDD vdd GND 1.8

* Load representing TIA input impedance
Rload to_chip GND 50

* Sources
VIN IN GND DC 0 AC 1 pulse(0 1 1n 100p 100p 5n 10n)

.control
* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1Meg 10G
let v_out_db = vdb(to_chip)
meas ac max_gain max v_out_db
meas ac bw_3db when v_out_db='max_gain - 3' fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 10p 20n
meas tran delay trig v(IN) val=0.5 rise=1 targ v(to_chip) val=0.012 rise=1

* DC Analysis
op
let power = -i(VDD) * 1.8
print power

quit
.endc
.end
